Workload_Assumptions.Target_Workload: Enterprise Domain Instruction SFT on Qwen2.5-72B / Llama-3.3-70B (200,000 Variable-Length Samples, Avg 950 Tokens, Max 8,192 Tokens, 152K Vocab)

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Unpacked Padded Full SFT (`[B, S_max=8192]`) + Materialized FP32 Logits Cross-Entropy (`[B, S, 152K]`)
Configuration_Matrix.Training_Stack: FSDP Full FT + Rectangular `[PAD]` Batching (88% Pad Waste) + Standard `nn.CrossEntropyLoss`
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Anti-pattern: 88% of FLOPs wasted on [PAD] tokens and 19.9GB HBM blown on materialized 152K vocabulary logits

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Naive `<eos>` Concatenation Packing without `cu_seqlens` Block-Diagonal Mask + Standard LoRA (`r=32`)
Configuration_Matrix.Training_Stack: Concatenate Samples into 8K Chunks, But Sample B Attends to Sample A's Tokens!
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Anti-pattern for instruction SFT: cross-sample attention contamination causes severe context-bleed hallucinations

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Full-Parameter FSDP2 + Multipack Block-Diagonal `cu_seqlens` Packing + `Liger-Kernel` Fused Linear Cross-Entropy
Configuration_Matrix.Training_Stack: Full 70B Weights Updated + Zero-Pad `cu_seqlens` + Chunked Fused CE/RMSNorm/SwiGLU
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Large continual pretraining (>1B tokens) or deep domain knowledge injection requiring full weight updates

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: All-Linear `LoRA+ / DoRA` (`r=64`, Asymmetric LR `lr_B = 16 * lr_A`) + Multipack `cu_seqlens` + `Liger-Kernel` Fused Linear CE + `NEFTune`
Configuration_Matrix.Training_Stack: 8-GPU Single Node; Zero-Contamination Packing + Zero-Logit-Materialization Fused CE + NEFTune (`alpha=5`)
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Production standard for enterprise instruction/tool/format SFT (6.5x faster useful tokens/s, -97.6% cost vs Tier 1)
